findings.description: Narrative delivery notes in Phase 159 mentioned that processed frames feed Thin-Plate Splines (TPS). In reality, the codebase implements a continuous 2D deformation grid with bilinear interpolation (WarpField2D).
findings.resolution: Reconciled. Code confirmed as WarpField2D. Narrative overclaim corrected.

findings.description: Reported latency of ≈ 9.2 ms was derived from a single run of unit test 4.3 in Node.js, not a statistical browser benchmark.
findings.resolution: Reconciled. Downgraded to single-run observational test timing in Node.js. Browser performance tagged as ENVIRONMENT PENDING.

findings.description: Absence of a single continuous real-time processing loop linking frame arrival directly to continuous spatial warping and composition without manual stepping.
findings.resolution: Formalized as mandatory core scope of Phase 160 (Real-Time Computer Vision Continuous Processing Loop, Frame Temporal Synchronization & Spatial Warping Compositor).

findings.description: Absence of physical GPU and hardware camera in headless Node.js/CI environment.
findings.resolution: Mitigated via typed test doubles (SimulatedWebGpuContext, SimulatedFrameSource, SimulatedWebWorker) and high-precision CPU fallback. Formally tracked as ENVIRONMENT PENDING.

phase160Readiness.rationale: All upstream interfaces and domain contracts across Fases 153-159 are stable, pure, and passing all tests. Technical debt HAL-005 provides the exact functional mandate for Phase 160.
